name: open-design
description: Design landing pages, decks, posters, social posts and more from 198 design systems, checked and exported to PNG, PDF and PowerPoint.

interface.longDescription: Open Design gives ChatGPT design recipes, 198 design systems and remixable examples. Ask for a poster, a pitch deck, a landing page or an Instagram carousel: it's built as a real page in one consistent style, checked in a browser, and exported to PNG, PDF or PowerPoint. Designs are saved in your Documents/Open Design folder. Runs on your computer; needs Node.js 18 or later.
defaultPrompt: Make a poster for our café's Saturday jazz night
Turn this report into a 10-slide deck
Design an Instagram carousel announcing our spring sale
